bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to environment; appropriating money to transport wood waste for processing.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; TRANSPORTING WOOD WASTE FOR PROCESSING.

$7,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Pollution Control Agency for a grant to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Nursery and Landscape Association to transport wood waste to wood waste facilities for processing.
additions: APPROPRIATION; TRANSPORTING WOOD WASTE FOR PROCESSING.
